title: 19.7. Pītittika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Napītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cattāri.
Nasukhasahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cattāri.
Naupekkhāsahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naupekkhāsahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cattāri. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
